summary: Frontend auth-guard regression test executed on public Expo preview URL. Fresh-session guards, role logins, role mismatch redirects, and logout protections mostly pass; one critical owner flow regression found.

ui_bugs.issue: Owner tapping testID=fab-buat-order does not navigate to /order-baru; user remains on owner dashboard due guard redirect.

integration_issues.issue: Role guard in app/_layout.tsx classifies 'order-baru' as employee-only route, conflicting with owner dashboard action that pushes /order-baru.

action_items: Fix guard route classification in frontend/app/_layout.tsx so owner can access /order-baru (or remove owner FAB route if not intended).
Retest owner create-order flow after guard update: login owner -> tap fab-buat-order -> confirm order-baru screen opens.
Keep current login redirect strategy (session-driven) in frontend/app/login.tsx; no eager router.replace in submit handler.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/app/_layout.tsx correctly waits auth hydration/loading and renders auth-session-loading before protected stack.
frontend/app/login.tsx no longer forces router.replace in doLogin/doRegister; redirect is session-driven via useEffect.
frontend/src/auth.tsx logout clears query cache and removes SESSION_KEY + VERSION_KEY as required.
frontend/src/api.ts still uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL instead of EXPO_BACKEND_URL policy key (consistency risk across environments).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use public URL https://wangi-dashboard.preview.emergentagent.com. For owner dashboard assertion use testID=fab-buat-order (notif-topup may not render). Credentials were read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md before testing.
rca_of_issue: RCA: app/_layout.tsx sets employeeRoutes={...(employee),hari-ini,order-baru,siap-diambil,...}. AuthGate computes roleMismatch when firstRoute='order-baru' and session.role!='pegawai'. Owner dashboard button (app/(owner)/index.tsx) pushes '/order-baru', causing immediate redirect back to owner home. Repro: login owner -> tap fab-buat-order -> URL remains '/' and order form never opens. Mitigation: allow owner for order-baru route or move owner order creation to owner-scoped route.
